<!-- docs-drift-check -->
### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **2** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, `@objectstack/spec`, touching **2** documentable anchor(s). ⚠️ **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/action.md`), so the pages documenting them are **NOT COVERED by this run** — this is not a clean bill of health for those files.

⛔ **2** release-owned page(s) name something this change touched. These are **read-only**:

- `content/docs/releases/v16.mdx`  _(via ActionParamSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_
- `content/docs/releases/v17/17-0.mdx`  _(via ActionParamSchema (symbol, a top-level const))_

> `content/docs/releases/` is RELEASE-OWNED (AGENTS.md "Documentation Guardrails"): release
> notes are written centrally at release time, and a code PR that edits them is the exact PR
> that guardrail exists to stop. They are still audited — read-only. If one of them is actually
> wrong, **file an issue** or open a dedicated docs-only PR; do not edit it here.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **3** changed file(s) yielded no anchor (`packages/spec/authorable-surface/ui.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`, `packages/spec/liveness/state-counts/action.md`) — pages documenting those are invisible to this run
- **2** name(s) were too generic to anchor anything (single lowercase words)
- the SDK route bridge reached **61** of **219** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **158** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **158**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **103** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **170** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cfb602c4595795c696dd07763abca3104dd4cf80` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `1415a8d34b0e555834586b1fcd261ef5d979e359` — the merge of head `1d215c5caf8c191915f424e74dda7715c01af0fc` into base `cfb602c4595795c696dd07763abca3104dd4cf80`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin 1415a8d34b0e555834586b1fcd261ef5d979e359 && git checkout 1415a8d34b0e555834586b1fcd261ef5d979e359
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin cfb602c4595795c696dd07763abca3104dd4cf80 1d215c5caf8c191915f424e74dda7715c01af0fc && git checkout -B drift-repro cfb602c4595795c696dd07763abca3104dd4cf80 && git merge --no-ff 1d215c5caf8c191915f424e74dda7715c01af0fc

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json cfb602c4595795c696dd07763abca3104dd4cf80
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs cfb602c4595795c696dd07763abca3104dd4cf80` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `792c7abe12b255d6f11d325b15083a7af76f1b05`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the full diff vs merge-base 959c26be1f (13 files); PR #30321 body and comments (6651034779, 6651041734); #30259 and comments (6649924151, 6649959478, 6651029910); #30117 and comments; #30260; check-runs on the head and the Check Changeset job log 127080786433; at origin/main: packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts, data/field.zod.ts:2360-2370, data/field-value.zod.ts:770-800, ui/bulk-action.zod.ts:191-330, ui/action-params.zod.ts:42, packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:3103-3119, ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts:290-350, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts:111, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramValueShape.ts:175-182, ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts:848-905, packages/lint/src/validate-object-references.ts:428-434, packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts:60-91,261-280, packages/spec/scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts:55-95,495-560,1160-1175, packages/spec/scripts/liveness/undrilled-containers.baseline.json:1-14,61, packages/spec/liveness/README.md:690-762, packages/spec/liveness/action.json:86-98,262-272, app.json:132-137, api-surface/ui.json, json-schema.manifest/ui.json, authorable-defaults/ui.json, platform-objects sys-user.object.ts:355-372, AGENTS.md:655-700,1019-1030, scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs:905-915, docs/adr/0131 D4 (:411-430), 0104 D2 (:230-275), 0049 (:1-34), 0087 (:732-765), 0078 header, skills/objectui/rules/protocol.md:309, skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md:174-175.

### ① Derived judgments

- Choice: `widget` on the param is the right surface. `permission-ref` is outside `FieldType` and the console itself marks it "Widget-hint only — not a declarable param type" (paramValueShape.ts:181). The ADR-0104 D2 argument holds at main: a `type` route would need `permission-ref` in `FieldType`, after which `valueSchemaFor` has no branch for it and returns the explicitly open `z.unknown()` (field-value.zod.ts:793-797), so the dispatcher's value check (action-execution.ts:3103-3119 resolves `{name,type,multiple,required,options}` and validates by `type`) would stop checking for a string. With `widget`, `type` stays `text` and D2 is untouched.
- Open `z.string()` matches `FieldSchema.widget` exactly (field.zod.ts:2370, `z.string().optional()`, "Degrades to the `type` renderer when unregistered"); no widget registry or vocabulary lint exists in `packages/spec` at main, so refusing or warning on an unknown name here would be a new, param-only regime diverging from the field key. Accepting anything is the consistent verdict, and the pin checks parity over seven values.
- Readers at main with a param carrying `widget`: spec parse door kept it (was `unrecognized_keys` before); runtime dispatcher ignores it (action-execution.ts:3108-3117 copies five named members); console resolver ignores it silently, and `widget` is not in `RESOLVED_ONLY_PARAM_KEYS` (resolveActionParams.ts:311-327) so no dev-mode warning fires; `paramToField` sets `field.widget` only for `boolean` (paramToField.ts:111); `i18n-extract` and `validate-object-references` (:428-434) read `label`/`reference`/`type` only; the AI tool builder is cloud-side (not measurable here). No reader drops or refuses the param.
- Pins (action-param-widget.test.ts, 17 cases): declared key (no `unrecognized_keys`), kept value, `type` unchanged, per-value parity with `FieldSchema.widget`, non-string refused at path `widget`, five existing shapes parse with no `widget` member. They would fail without the change (9/17 red under the reported key-rename ablation, which is consistent with the cases).
- TSDoc (action.zod.ts, the new block) cites ADR-0131 D4 and names #30260 as the reader. The `.describe()`, which is what the docs reference and JSON Schema hand to authors, does not: it says "picks a permission set by name" and "Degrades … when unregistered", which is not true today for any name (see ④).
- Generated surfaces: `authorable-surface/ui.json` (+`ui/ActionParam:widget`), `content/docs/references/ui/action.mdx` (three tables) and the four `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts` bundles are in the diff. `api-surface/ui.json` records export existence only (ActionParamSchema (const) unchanged), `json-schema.manifest/ui.json` lists schema names, `authorable-defaults/ui.json` lists defaulted keys only; none is moved by an optional key with no default. Count pins moved honestly (18→19, 701→702).
- Scope: `sys-user.object.ts` untouched and the body names #30117's server PR as the switch. `BulkActionParamSchema` (bulk-action.zod.ts:191ff) is a divergent dialect (`help`/`default`/`object`) with no `widget`; the card asked for one surface, and skipping bulk parity is justified and stated.
- Body matches code: `Fixes #30259`, `Part of #30117`, `Prior rulings read:`, `Skills-docs:` (both cited skills lines verified at main), 维护者速读, reader table. One overstatement: "the `params` row records `widget` as PLANNED" — the row's status is `live`; PLANNED is a sentence in its `note`.
- Check-runs on the head: `Check Changeset` FAILURE (see ②); `Spec property liveness`, PR-body guards, dispatch-gates green; build/test/typecheck lanes in progress at review time. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` NOT MEASURED locally per the report; noted, not failed on.

### ② Semver level

- `Clause-②: yes (widening)`: correct. Every existing param parses unchanged (pinned); the strictObject accepts one more optional key.
- `minor` on `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects`: correct level for a new authorable key on moved packages (AGENTS.md:1023-1026).
- MUST-FIX: `Metadata-protocol: additive` is not in the closed set `added|narrowed|semantic|none` (AGENTS.md:1023; check-changeset-no-major.mjs:907-911). The gate on this head reads it as "MALFORMED, not a declaration", reports "LEVEL AXIS: NOT MEASURED", and `Check Changeset` is red (job 127080786433). The PR body and `.changeset/30259-action-param-widget.md` both carry `additive`; AGENTS.md requires the line in both. Change both to `Metadata-protocol: added` (the body edit clears the check on the next `edited` event; the changeset needs a commit).
- ADR-0087: no conversion owed — nothing removed, renamed or narrowed; the `adr-0087` comment marker is required only on declared-breaking changesets and `check-adr-0087-registration` is green.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Liveness (SHOULD-FIX). The reader obligation is prose only. `action/params` is a `recorded` container (undrilled-containers.baseline.json:61), so the gate asks no verdict for `params.widget`; the PLANNED record is in the `note` of a `live` row, and `note` is scanned by nothing (check-liveness.mts:540-549). The ledger's own header names exactly this form as the one the baseline replaced: "a reassuring sentence in a `note` … cost nothing to write and could not be checked" (baseline `_containers`; README.md:748-750). Consequences: nothing goes red if #30260 never lands or lands differently, and the author-side lint, which warns only from ledger rows at any `children` depth (lint-liveness-properties.ts:75-91, 273-276), gives an author who writes `widget` today no `liveness-planned-property` warning, so the key ships accepted in silence. The card asked for "its liveness row with the reader that slice 2 adds". The dev's reason (a drill is evidence for ~20 members; a partial drill fails the schema→ledger pass) is correct, and the deviation is recorded in the os-dev-report. Minimum honest form: either drill `action/params` (children with per-member evidence, remove the baseline row, `widget` as `planned` + `authorWarn` + `authorHint` naming #30260, the same ledger's `overrides` row at action.json:263-270 and app.json:132-137 are the precedent), or keep the note but say in the body and on #30259 that the card's row ask is NOT met, that no lint warns on the key until the drill, and name the drill's carrier (#30260 or a card).
- Describe honesty (SHOULD-FIX, small). The `.describe()` and the generated reference tell authors `widget: 'permission-ref'` "picks a permission set by name" now; until #30260 every name draws the `type` renderer. Add the not-read-until-#30260 clause to the describe (TSDoc has it; authors read the describe), to be removed by #30260.
- Body wording (SHOULD-FIX, folds into the first): "records `widget` as PLANNED" should say the row stays `live` and the record is a note.

### ④ Design judgment

The surface choice is sound and the smallest one that keeps ADR-0104 D2 intact and reuses the field key's vocabulary and degradation. The widening is honest and fully pinned, and every generated surface a new optional key moves is regenerated. The two defects are declaration and record hygiene, not design: the protocol line is malformed and blocks the level gate, and the ADR-0049-style reader obligation is held by an unscanned sentence rather than by the ledger. `dual-build-cjs-loads` was not measured locally; CI runs it.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `1d215c5caf8c191915f424e74dda7715c01af0fc`
Local-runs: none
Scope: the delta `792c7abe..1d215c5c` (7 files) and the full diff vs merge-base 959c26be1f (16 files); PR #30321 body and comments (6651034779, 6651041734, 6651175841, 6652453553) and the os-dev-report 6652427201 on #30259; #30260 body; check-runs on the head, the Check Changeset job logs 127097588033 (failure) and 127114043465 (success); at origin/main: packages/spec/liveness/README.md:76-130,581-760, action.json:146-150,263-290, app.json:132-137, scripts/liveness/check-liveness.mts:536,925-945,1098-1116,1142-1150,1205-1230, scripts/liveness/undrilled-containers.baseline.json:1-14,61, packages/lint/src/lint-liveness-properties.ts:60-95,431-460,468-487,542-544, ui/packages/fields/src/resolveActionParams.ts:252-282,580-700, ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionParamDialog.tsx:251-275,329-360,398-412,487-900, ui/packages/app-shell/src/utils/paramToField.ts:60-160, packages/runtime/src/action-execution.ts:2967-3010,3103-3120, packages/spec/src/ui/action-params.zod.ts:197-240, packages/spec/src/data/field-value.zod.ts:735, ui/packages/core/src/evaluator/optionRules.ts:93-107,217-227, packages/spec/src/kernel/public-auth-features.ts:421, scripts/check-doc-authoring.mjs:101,385-410,516; at the head: packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts:150-330,527,618, liveness/action.json params subtree, lint-liveness-properties.test.ts:72,190-216; AGENTS.md:14-17,1019-1036.

### ① Derived judgments

- 6651175841, finding by finding. MUST (`Metadata-protocol: additive`): closed — the changeset line reads `added` (delta, .changeset/30259-action-param-widget.md:9) and the live body carries `Metadata-protocol: added`. Check Changeset on this head: the 06:52Z run 127097588033 failed reading the then-unpatched body (its log quotes `Metadata-protocol: additive`); the 07:35Z `pull_request` run 127114043465 completed `success` at 07:36:53Z. Green now. SHOULD (ledger prose): closed by the drill (below). SHOULD (describe): closed — the describe and all three regenerated action.mdx tables carry "Not read yet: until the console's action dialog passes it through, the dialog draws every param with its `type` renderer whatever this names." SHOULD (body "PLANNED"): closed — the body now says the row is `planned` with `authorWarn` and names the drill.
- The drill, checked member by member at main (all 22, not a sample). Every anchor resolves to an exported or module-level symbol in the cited file (resolveActionParam :580, resolveOptionLabels :252, ActionParamDialog :487, filterVisibleParams :251, serializeParamValues :329, CarryOverParam :398, paramToField :83, resolveDeclaredActionParams :3103, summarizeActionParams :2967, validateActionParams :197, resolveCascadingOptions :217, lowerRequiresFeature :421), and each symbol reads the member it is cited for: resolveActionParam reads `name/field/objectOverride(:56 ownerName)/label/type/required/options/placeholder/helpText/defaultValue/visible/carryOver/multiple/accept/maxSize/reference(→referenceTo)/defaultFromRow(:14)`; the dialog keys state and errors by `name`, seeds `defaultValue` (:83), blocks on `required` (:118), localises `label`/`helpText`/option `label` (:219-223), branches on `carryOver` (:251; serializeParamValues :7,:31), filterVisibleParams reads `p.visible`; paramToField copies `type/required/placeholder/options/multiple/accept/maxSize` and degrades a targetless `reference` (paramDegradesWithoutTarget); the dispatcher copies `name/field/type/multiple/required/options` (:3107-3116) and summarizeActionParams reads `label`/`helpText`; validateActionParams hands `type/multiple/options` to valueSchemaFor (:32), whose membership is over `o.value` (field-value.zod.ts:735); `requiresFeature` is the ActionParamSchema `.transform` at action.zod.ts:618. The `widget` verdict is right: `widget` appears nowhere in resolveActionParams.ts, paramToField.ts sets `field.widget` only for `boolean`, and action-execution.ts names neither `widget` nor `objectOverride` — so the `planned` grade and the `objectOverride` "console only" note are both measured truth. Nit, no fix owed: `options.value` / `options.visibleWhen` anchor the exported entry `resolveCascadingOptions`; the actual read is one call down in `resolveVisibleOptions` (optionRules.ts:93-107), same file.
- Shape against the ledger's rules and precedents: `file#symbol` anchor grammar (README:93-110), `verifiedAt` 2026-11-05 on every child (today, not future), `evidenceScope: in-repo`, `planned` + `authorWarn: true` + `authorHint` opening "Keep it, but nothing reads it yet:" mirrors app.json:132-137 `navigation.dataSource` exactly, and the `PLANNED RECORD (…)` note naming the carrier mirrors action.json:263-270 `overrides`. `requiresFeature` uses the `#symbol` form where the action-level row (:148) still uses a parenthetical — an improvement, not a divergence. No child inherits by fan-out; the container row keeps its own cross-repo AI-tool evidence and its 2026-09-15 date, which is honest since that pointer was not re-read.
- Counts and baseline: drillChildren (check-liveness.mts:1098-1110) grades leaves only, so `params` and `options` stop counting as rows: 51 − 2 + 21 live = 70, planned 2 + 1 = 3, dead 1, classified 74. `action/params` is the only baseline row naming that coordinate at main (:61) and none remains at the head; `Spec property liveness` is green on the head, which is the gate's own word that anchors resolve, key mentions hold, the baseline has no stale row and the shards reconcile.
- Author lint: ledgerRows flattens every `children` depth (:75-93), getNested fans a dotted path over array levels (:468-487), `action`/`actions` is in TYPE_COLLECTIONS (:544), the message is `sets \`${path}\`` (:450) and the hint is `entry.authorHint ?? defaultHint` (:447). The pin (test :190-216) asserts exactly one `liveness-planned-property` finding whose hint contains "nothing reads it yet", six live siblings silent by `ruleOf`, and a widget-less action silent. Test Core shards are green on the head. The pin would go red if the row lost `authorWarn`, the drill, or the array fan-out.
- Delta scope: the seven delta files are the changeset line, the describe + `//` pointer, the drill, the counts shard, the baseline row, the regenerated reference and the lint pin — nothing beyond the review's asks. The `objectOverride` server-side gap found while drilling is recorded on the row and in the dev report as an observation with no carrier; it is outside this card and not changed here.

### ② Semver level

- Unchanged from 6651175841: `Clause-②: yes (widening)` correct, `minor` on `@objectstack/spec` and `@objectstack/platform-objects` correct, and `Metadata-protocol: added` is now a member of the closed set in both the body and the changeset (AGENTS.md:1023). ADR-0087: nothing owed.

### ③ Boundary flags

- Issue ids out of the author-facing text (question 4): right outcome, slightly imprecise attribution. AGENTS.md:14-17 bans a tracker number in anything an author is shown, and README:607 says `authorHint` is shown; check-doc-authoring's Rule 3 scans `.describe()` prose under packages/spec/src (:385-410, :516) but its ROOTS (:101) do not reach `packages/spec/liveness/*.json`, so the authorHint constraint comes from the rule, not the gate. No fix.
- SHOULD-FIX (small, non-blocking): the flip obligation is findable by a person but by no check. #30260 is named in the row's `note`, the TSDoc, the `//` comment, the changeset and the PR body — and every one of those is prose nothing scans (check-liveness.mts:536-549 scans `evidence`, never `note`). #30260's own body (open, os-zhuang) says nothing about the ledger row, the `authorWarn`, or the describe's "Not read yet" sentence. If #30260 lands without the flip, nothing goes red: `os validate` / `os lint` simply keep warning authors that nothing reads a key the console now reads, and the `verifiedAt` clock only adds a non-failing worklist line. This matches the ledger's precedent (overrides, dataSource carry their carrier in the note the same way), so it is not a defect of the PR; the cheap close is one comment on #30260 listing what it must flip: `action/params.widget` → `live` with the pass-through cited, drop `authorWarn`/`authorHint`, delete the describe's last sentence and the `//` comment, and the two Skills-docs lines the body owes.

### ④ Design judgment

The surface choice stands as reviewed. The fix round turned the reader obligation from an unscannable sentence into 22 measured verdicts, each anchored on the symbol that reads the member, with the one planned member warning its authors through the shipped ledger and a pin that keeps it warning; the declaration axis is well-formed and green. The remaining gap is hand-off hygiene on the successor issue, not this diff.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** 动作参数 `ActionParamSchema` 新增可选键 `widget`，和字段上的 `widget` 同名、同词汇，用来指定画这个参数的控件（比如权限集选择器 `permission-ref`）。`type` 仍是值的类型。
- **为什么改：** 新建用户时「权限集」只是一个认机器名的文本框（#30117）。授权表那一列早就用 `permission-ref` 选择器（ADR-0131 D4），动作参数却没有办法请求它。这是拆分后的第一片：先让规范能表达。
- **风险与回滚：** 纯新增可选键，不写的参数照旧解析。控制台要等 #30260 才读它，所以存活度账本把它记为 planned，作者写了会收到 lint 提醒。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`；`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`（`params` 逐成员判定）；`action-param-widget.test.ts`。
- **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec exec vitest run src/ui/action-param-widget.test.ts`，预期 17 passed。
